title: Rating agent writes three or four when promoted, and reacts to changes
description:
At `draft` and above the agent writes its rating as a machine rating (actor recorded), still three or four only, and adds change triggers: a Story published, a Reference accepted. A machine rating is replaced by any person's rating. Five-star candidates still go to a person. With this, `publishRequiresRating` can be on without a person rating everything.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A newly published Story is rated within the quiet window.
- A five is never written by the agent at any rung.
- A person's later rating replaces the machine's.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- rating-writes.feature: a publish is rated three or four; the actor is the agent; a person's rating replaces it; an attempt at five is refused by the gate.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** First agent: rating and curation on one site. Slice code L3 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
